name: Fujimi Suzu
source: A part-time worker at "Supernova", and the bassist and leader of the all-girls' band [url=/s7539]Dai Ichi Uchuu Sokudo[/url]. She is also [url=/c22678]Ena's[/url] older sister. Once upon a time she used do girls' wrestling, and knows how to drop some good drop kicks. She often threatens to use these whenever she gets annoyed.
